description: This source file defines a serializer and copier for the generic Queue<T> type, including serialization/deserialization logic and deep copying capabilities, primarily for use with Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: QueueCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Queue<T> objects, handling writing to and reading from serialized format.

classes.name: QueueCopier<T>
classes.description: Deep copy implementation for Queue<T> collection.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Queue<T> into a writer stream, writing length and each element using the provided field codec.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Queue<T> from a reader stream, reconstructing the queue and elements.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Queue<T> instance with elements duplicated.
